answer: Make identity post collateral. Think of the network as a busy wharf: each arriving agent parks a refundable bond before unloading work, and a rotating challenger panel holds a mirror to its outputs to confirm they aren't clones of existing accounts. Proven duplication forfeits the bond to the challengers. Mass identities now cost capital instead of nothing, so an attacker's ivory-plated fleet of fakes turns into a compounding liability rather than free yield.
